projects.title: NASA First Woman
projects.summary: Production systems and real-time content for an XR platform built around lunar exploration education.
projects.overview: NASA First Woman is an educational XR platform. My contribution sits at the intersection of authored visual content, real-time implementation, and production constraints across target platforms.
scope: Technical-art support for real-time content production
Integration work between authored assets and runtime systems
Reusable workflows designed for production iteration
constraints: Real-time visual quality within platform performance budgets
Maintainable content across more than one target configuration
Clear hand-off between artists, technical artists, and engineers
projects.outcome: The platform was recognized with American Advertising Awards. This public record intentionally summarizes system-level responsibilities without exposing protected production details.

projects.title: Meta × Blumhouse
projects.summary: Atmospheric effects and engine-facing workflows for the Blumhouse Enhanced Cinema experience at Nexus Studios for Meta.
projects.overview: The project required production-ready visual systems for an immersive experience rather than isolated final-frame effects. The technical-art work focused on carrying visual intent into a constrained real-time environment.
scope: Real-time VFX and atmospheric system development
Engine-facing workflows for repeatable content integration
Technical collaboration across art and engineering disciplines
constraints: Stable behaviour across production content and target hardware
Visual consistency without one-off, shot-specific solutions
projects.outcome: The Blumhouse Enhanced Cinema experience was Emmy-nominated. The page records the technical context while respecting the limits of publicly shareable production material.

projects.title: FAA Interaction Screen
projects.summary: Responsive visual systems for a large-format airport interaction screen.
projects.overview: This work belongs to the practical side of real-time graphics: a public-facing interactive surface that must remain legible, responsive, and stable outside a controlled demo environment.
scope: Real-time visual implementation for an interactive display
Iteration with design and development stakeholders
constraints: Reliable continuous operation in a public installation
Readability and responsiveness at large display scale
Predictable behaviour under real production conditions
projects.outcome: The public portfolio record focuses on the interaction and real-time production context. A deeper technical breakdown can be added when project material is cleared for publication.

projects.title: Deloitte Virtual Factory
projects.summary: Environment and production workflows for an industrial virtual-factory platform.
projects.overview: The project combined environment production with the structure and maintainability expected from an industrial real-time platform. The work was less about a single image and more about keeping content usable as the system evolved.
scope: Production workflows for repeatable scene integration
Technical-art coordination between authored content and runtime needs
constraints: Maintainable workflows for ongoing production changes
Real-time performance across complex industrial content
projects.outcome: The result is documented as a production-system record. Additional diagrams and implementation notes can be appended without changing the page structure.
